steps.title: Question strategy: vary purpose, register and follow-up
steps.body: A useful information exchange is not a list of unrelated questions. Start broad, then ask for a detail, clarify an unfamiliar answer and confirm the next step. Use est-ce que or intonation in neutral conversation; use pourriez-vous / sauriez-vous for a polite request; use inversion selectively in formal questions (À quelle date commence le cours ?). Indirect questions use statement word order: Pourriez-vous me dire à quelle date le cours commence ? Do not keep inversion inside the indirect clause. Use pronouns only after the reference is clear.

steps.title: Question strategy: vary purpose, register and follow-up
rows: Est-ce que le matériel est compris ?
Pouvez-vous me dire à quelle date le cours commence ?
Can you tell me on what date the course begins?
What do you mean by a recent supporting document?
Si j'ai bien compris, je recevrai un courriel demain.
If I understood correctly, I will receive an email tomorrow.

steps.prompt: Which phrase politely asks for clarification?
steps.explain: Pourriez-vous is a polite conditional request.

steps.prompt: What should follow an incomplete answer?
steps.explain: Use the answer to decide what detail to ask next.
